question: State whether the following statements are 'True' or 'False': (a) A govt servant can be reduced in rank to a post not held by him earlier in the cadre (b) An appeal may be allowed against an order of suspension. (c) Officer performing current duties of a post cannot exercise statutory powers under the rules. (d) No order imposing any of the major penalties shall be made except after an inquiry held in the manner provided under Rule 14 of CCS(CCA) Rules, 1965 (e) Suspension order may be extended beyond 3 months, even if within this period memorandum of charges/chargesheet is not served on the govt servant.

Fill in the blanks: (a) Unless unavoidable, the Disciplinary Authority should __________ from being Inquiry Officer (b) Inquiry Officer should be __________ in rank to the officer to be enquired against. (c) Minor penalties can be imposed against govt servant under Rule __________ of CCS(CCA) Rules, 1965 (d) Inquiry is __________ if charge is not accepted by the govt servant. (e) A govt servant under suspension entitles to receive Subsistence Allowance subject to production of __________ certificate.
